## What
Extend test coverage for the degradation CLI flags being added to preconditions-record.sh (T2). Tests must fail before T2 is implemented (RED phase).

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-preconditions-record.sh — add test_degradation_cli_flags() covering: --degradation flag presence, --degradation-type enum validation (valid values pass, invalid value exits 1), both flags together inject into data JSON
- tests/scripts/test-preconditions-degradation.sh — NEW file: behavioral test for null-coalescing on a mixed fixture (some events have data.degradation, some don't; reader must not fail on absent field)
- .test-index — add RED marker [test_degradation_cli_flags] for plugins/dso/scripts/preconditions-record.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- Given --degradation flag is present, When preconditions-record.sh runs, Then data JSON contains degradation:true
- Given --degradation-type inferred_decision, When preconditions-record.sh runs, Then data JSON contains degradation_type:"inferred_decision"
- Given --degradation-type invalid_value, When preconditions-record.sh runs, Then script exits 1 with error message
- Given a mixed fixture (some PRECONDITIONS events with data.degradation, some without), When _read_latest_preconditions() runs, Then it returns without error and null-coalesces missing field
- All new tests FAIL before T2 is implemented (confirmed RED state)

## Done Definitions
- DD1 enum constraint tested at CLI boundary (invalid enum exits 1)
- .test-index RED marker added so pre-commit gate allows committing failing tests

comments.body:
GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT: Additional acceptance criteria from gap analysis:

- Given caller passes both --data '{"foo":"bar"}' and --degradation-type inferred_decision, When script runs, Then data JSON contains BOTH foo:bar AND degradation_type:"inferred_decision" (merge, not overwrite) — tests the core DD2 backwards-compat risk
- Given --degradation-type is provided WITHOUT --degradation flag (or vice versa), When script runs, Then behavior must be defined: either both required together OR each is independent — pin this contract in the RED test before T2 implements it
